meta.source: Government of Tamil Nadu Standard Six Social Science Term I 2025 English and Tamil editions supplied by the user
meta.extraction_policy: Source-exhaustive bilingual framing from timeline, discovery narrative, site map, archaeology methods, town-planning diagrams, drainage/Great Bath/Granary/Assembly Hall, trade and technology, material culture, script/apparel/ornaments, religion/governance/occupations, pottery/toys, decline, summary/glossary, exercises, HOTS, activities, rapid-fire, map work and answer grid. No outside corrections are silently inserted.
source_notes: Both English and Tamil 2025 Term I books were used. Unit 3 uses the same printed page numbering, 132–148, in both editions.
The Harappan-site map and town-planning diagrams were inspected visually; only clearly readable labels were converted into questions.
The textbook prints the Lothal ivory-scale smallest division as '1704mm'. That wording is preserved as a source-specific fact rather than silently corrected.
The chapter lists several possible causes for Harappan decline; none is promoted as the single proven cause.
Where exercise/matching layouts are crossed or ambiguous, answers are drawn from the lesson text rather than from visual adjacency.
meta.question_style: Natural competitive-exam wording; no routine 'according to the textbook' phrasing.
meta.quality_policy: Competitive-exam useful questions only. Classroom stories, activity props, learning-objective recall, ICT steps, picture trivia and conceptual duplicates removed.
